L_t (leader daily equity for proportional sizing) = linear interpolation of portfolio.allTime.accountValueHistory to each day's 00:00 UTC boundary, minus cumulative net EXTERNAL ledger flow since W0 (deposit/withdraw, plus spotTransfer/send to a different address); 4 such events fell inside W. Falls back to the leader's own fills-based MTM curve on 1 day(s) outside accountValueHistory's covered range. Internal moves (accountClassTransfer, same-address dex sends, subAccountTransfer, internalTransfer) are not netted.

L_t (leader daily equity) was <=1% of E0 on 41/92 day(s) of the full-history window (min ratio observed for the proportional sizing multiplier reached 2.5x); this is a real characteristic of this wallet's capital history (large early swings/withdrawals relative to its tiny starting E0), not a computation bug — it drives outsized D2/gate leverage numbers when it occurs.

D1-c loss(e) = -qty*(p_recon - p_exec) - (catch-up slippage + catch-up fee), per plan §3 D1-c; does not add back the fee/slippage the original (now-skipped) t+δ trade would have paid — the formula as given only subtracts the catch-up leg's own friction, so loss(e) is the INCREMENTAL cost of deferring this one trade, not a full swap-accounting of both legs.
D2/gate denominators (peak/day-equity C_t) floored at 1% of E0 on at least one day to avoid divide-by-zero
